name: Tobira Site Agent
tagline: Turn your website into an AI agent that sells to AI agents
description: People already find you through AI. Tobira turns that AI traffic into real leads and customers. Paste your URL and in 10 minutes your website becomes an AI agent. It answers people and their AI, negotiates, books calls and takes orders right in customers' ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other AI chats. Leads go to your Telegram or email. Also, AI agents read your site 2x faster and take action without navigating its interface. Free with your own AI key.

name: Turnstone
tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
description: Turnstone is a Grok Bot alternative that runs on the AI you already have. Connect your own AI subscriptions, an API key, or your self-hosted model. When one hits its usage limit, your Agent switches to another and keeps going. Works on your Mac and iPhone. Completely free.

name: Rankfender v3.0
tagline: The SEO/GEO operating system, built for people and AI agents
description: Built for marketers, founders and agencies tired of switching between SEO tools. Rankfender 3.0 brings keyword research, rank tracking incl. AI Overviews, competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, traffic, content and Social, and strategy into one place, and adds what the old tools miss: how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and 4 more AI assistants talk about your brand. Work in the app, or connect Claude or ChatGPT and let your AI agent run it.

name: Wonder Dev View
tagline: Run many Claude Code and Codex agents in parallel
description: Run Claude Code and Codex on your subscriptions, in parallel worktrees. Have one review the other’s code, then try your app beside the design. Select an element in Preview and tell your agent what to change.

name: EdgeBar
tagline: Control your Mac’s volume and brightness from the trackpad
description: EdgeBar turns your MacBook trackpad edges into smooth volume and brightness controls, with haptic feedback. Slide the right edge for volume and the left for brightness, with the same on-screen display as the keyboard keys and a light haptic tick as you go. Double-tap the top-right corner to mute, swipe the bottom edge to skip tracks. Lives in the menu bar, uses almost no CPU. $9 once, with lifetime updates.

name: Mechvibes 3
tagline: Give your keyboard and mouse any sound you like
description: Mechvibes plays a sound for every key you press and every click, in any app. Pick from the community library, from mechanical switches to typewriters and game sounds, or make your own in the browser. Free and open source, for Windows, Linux and Mac.

name: Datastripes Data Stories
tagline: Turn any spreadsheet into a data story in seconds
description: Upload a CSV or Excel file and Datastripes writes the story behind it: headlines, charts and findings in plain English. Pick the questions, check your conclusion against the data, then publish in 8 formats and your brand colors. Every dataset has a story in it, but getting it out usually takes an analyst, a designer and a writer. We built Datastripes Data Story so one person with a spreadsheet can do it in minutes.

name: Meadow
tagline: Hidden songs on your walk, chosen by people, not algorithms
description: Meadow lets you plant a song at a real place. Walk by and you can listen to what someone left there, collect it, and plant your own for the next person. No algorithm, just music that people chose for a place. Collect songs with your phone in your pocket using Live Activities, keep every find in your Garden, turn it into an Apple Music playlist, and see what your city is playing in the Feed. Free on TestFlight for iPhone.

name: DALI AI by SupplyzPro
tagline: The ERP you never need to open
description: Discover SupplyzPro: a simple, all-in-one, AI-powered workspace to manage your business: sales and purchases, real-time inventory, invoicing, suppliers, payments, and more. Just text: https://wa.me/21658299567?text=hello

name: Pauta
tagline: Your private memory for every conversation
description: Pauta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and voice notes, then turns them into summaries and action items. It works fully offline, keeps your data on your device, and only connects to external AI if you choose.

name: chalk
tagline: learn anything, anywhere
description: chalk teaches by showing you. On your Mac, hold ⌘⌥ and ask about anything on your screen: chalk answers out loud, marks the real button, and walks you through one step at a time. Or say what you want to learn, and it draws you a board, plans a course of classes you do (not just read), or takes you through a whole project in stages. It writes up your lectures against your slides, too. Boards and courses work in any browser. Free to start.

name: Enhanced for Todoist
tagline: More ways to organise, plan and focus with Todoist
description: A new front end for your Todoist account, with editable tables, saved project views, flexible timeframes, workload estimates, guided reviews and a task-linked Pomodoro timer. Free and open source, with a demo you can try without signing in.

name: refern.
tagline: Every visual reference you work from, in one place.
description: refern keeps your images, videos, working files, and saved web pages in one library. Find any reference by tag or color, put any file on a board, and pin it on top of your drawing app. Your files stay in your own folders. Windows, macOS, and Linux.

name: axel.md
tagline: Agent orchestration in the terminal, designed for Rex
description: Threads and named agents, back in the terminal. Axel orchestrates Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agents on Rex: durable sessions, status the terminal understands, and your other machines over Tailscale.

name: Kodivo
tagline: Learn coding with AI and PHP through swipeable cards
description: Swipe through short lessons on coding with AI and PHP. Learn how coding agents work, understand code examples, and test yourself with exercises and explained answers. Connect Codex or Claude Code through MCP to continue with your saved progress.

name: Cursor Craft
tagline: Custom cursors for Mac
description: Cursor Craft is a free macOS app for browsing, installing, and switching custom cursor sets in one click. Choose from free and premium packs across minimal, nature, neon, cats, anime, and more.

name: Thunderduck Inc.
tagline: Modular Data Warehouse for Agentic Data Teams
description: Thunderduck is a DuckDB-powered data warehouse built for AI agents. Every agent gets its own isolated engine. Join Postgres, BigQuery, Iceberg and S3 files in one SQL query, with no ETL. Every query is priced before it runs. Managed cloud, BYOC or on-prem.

name: Winq
tagline: Focus on a window or display you're looking at
description: Gaze focus for macOS from your Mac's camera: look at a display or a window and Winq focuses it, with the pointer where you're looking. Head and eyes both count, it waits while you type or use the mouse, and it keeps learning from your clicks. For multi-monitor setups, developers, and anyone who wants their hands on the keyboard. On-device and private. Free for a day.

name: Pressure
tagline: Need a second opinion? Have two agents debate your topic
description: Ask a question and two AI models from different labs argue it out, then you get a pinned summary: the positions, the concessions, the conclusion, and what is still open. Debate a decision, review a spec, research with cited sources, or pressure-test a rough idea. Start a debate on the web with no signup, add Pressure to Claude as a connector, or install the CLI for Claude Code and Codex in one line.

name: Codiclens
tagline: Local AI powerd Mac launcher and file finder
description: Describe what you want and Codiclens finds it: an app, a file or something you copied, by what's in it, not just its name. A free, open-source launcher that runs on your Mac. 100% local.
